latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release — instantly turn your photos into shareable videos on Canva, powered by cloud AI.

- Upload JPG, PNG, WEBP, or HEIC images (up to 200MB each); receive 1080p MP4 videos with transitions and background music.
- No software to install; all processing happens server-side for speed and simplicity.
- Automatic session setup and free token support for quick onboarding.
- Simple commands for export, status, credits, uploads, and video generation.
- Error handling for file size, formats, credits, and connection issues.
- Built for marketers, content creators, and small business owners needing fast, professional-looking video edits.
